meren.goal: Build a Golgari sacrifice and creature-recursion value deck, reusing useful entry/death effects and interaction. Explore direct and indirect support. No existing decklist, budget, bracket, or combo restriction is supplied.

diagnostics.Viscera Seer: Reusable sacrifice of other creatures, unlike a self-sacrificing creature.
diagnostics.Yawgmoth, Thran Physician: Sacrifice/draw/control plus proliferating player experience and discarding creature targets.
diagnostics.Cankerbloom: Self-sacrifice utility plus proliferation of existing player experience.
diagnostics.Evolution Sage: Landfall can proliferate player experience without a death event.
diagnostics.Plaguecrafter: Recurring entry-based interaction, not a general on-demand outlet.
diagnostics.Spore Frog: Self-sacrifice and recurring protection, not an outlet for other creatures.
diagnostics.Sakura-Tribe Elder: Self-sacrifice ramp can be reused; it does not sacrifice other creatures.
diagnostics.Grim Haruspex: Death draw excludes tokens and itself.
diagnostics.Morbid Opportunist: Other creature deaths draw only once per turn.
diagnostics.Beast Whisperer: Cast draw does not trigger on direct battlefield reanimation; still useful for casting.
diagnostics.Doubling Season: Its counter clause does not double player experience; token relevance is conditional.
diagnostics.Grafdigger's Cage: Blocks Meren's battlefield-return mode, although her hand-return mode remains possible.
diagnostics.Ground Seal: Prevents Meren from targeting creature cards in graveyards.

saheeli.goal: Build a Temur artifact/energy-and-copy value deck with combat payoffs. Develop sustained energy and useful copy targets. No existing decklist, budget, bracket, or combo restriction is supplied.

diagnostics.Whirler Virtuoso: An Artificer, not originally an artifact; copied entry refunds three energy.
diagnostics.Izzet Generatorium: Adds energy to each future gain event; Saheeli's three-energy payment alone does not unlock its four-energy draw condition.
diagnostics.Decoction Module: Saheeli copies enter as creatures, triggering energy generation.
diagnostics.Evolution Sage: Proliferate can increase existing energy on the player, not create the first counter.
diagnostics.Thought Monitor: Affinity can discount the original; copies give entry-based draw.
diagnostics.Solemn Simulacrum: Copied entry ramps and copied death draws.
diagnostics.Myr Battlesphere: Entry-created Myr remain after the Saheeli copy is sacrificed.
diagnostics.Wurmcoil Engine: The temporary copy has a 5/5 base, and its death creates lasting Wurms.
diagnostics.Meteor Golem: A copy provides entry-based nonland removal but the original is expensive.
diagnostics.Panharmonicon: Doubles relevant entry triggers, not Saheeli's cast/combat triggers directly.
diagnostics.Second Harvest: Independent copies do not inherit Saheeli's separate delayed sacrifice.
diagnostics.Sundial of the Infinite: Wait for the sacrifice trigger to be on the stack; using it before the end step postpones the trigger.
diagnostics.Brudiclad, Telchor Engineer: Resolve Saheeli before Brudiclad to select the new copy; ordinary tokens do not acquire its delayed sacrifice.
diagnostics.Doubling Season: Doubles created tokens but not energy counters on players; both original-event copies remain subject to sacrifice.
diagnostics.Hangarback Walker: Existing counters are not copied and X is zero; a Saheeli copy has a 5/5 base but no inherited counters for its death payoff.
diagnostics.Torpor Orb: Suppresses creature-entry triggers including those of Saheeli's creature copies, not her cast/combat triggers.
